mappings.agentic_failure_mode: User or retrieved content changes the agent goal or overrides higher-priority instructions
mappings.minimum_test: Run direct and indirect prompt-injection cases against every externally exposed agent workflow
mappings.release_gate: Block release when high-severity instruction override succeeds

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: Agent invokes an approved tool for an unapproved purpose or with unsafe parameters
mappings.minimum_test: Replay high-impact tool calls with malformed and adversarial arguments
mappings.release_gate: Block release when unsafe tool action executes without approval
mappings.monitoring_signal: High-risk tool call without matching approval ID

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: Agent uses broad service credentials or acts beyond the user or task authority
mappings.minimum_test: Attempt role escalation, cross-tenant access, and delegated-action replay
mappings.release_gate: Block release when tool access is not bound to identity and task scope
mappings.monitoring_signal: Tool call using unexpected credential context

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: Agent exposes regulated or confidential data through responses, tools, logs, memory, or provider calls
mappings.minimum_test: Run sensitive-data prompts and retrieval cases across prompt, output, log, and tool traces
mappings.release_gate: Block release when regulated data leaves an approved boundary
mappings.monitoring_signal: Unexpected sensitive-data pattern in output or logs

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: Untrusted content is promoted into agent memory or long-term state and later influences decisions
mappings.minimum_test: Inject conflicting or malicious memory items and verify promotion controls
mappings.release_gate: Block release when unreviewed memory changes can affect high-impact actions
mappings.monitoring_signal: Memory write from untrusted source or expired state

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: Plugins, skills, tools, prompts, models, or dependencies change agent behavior without review
mappings.minimum_test: Review dependency, prompt, model, and tool changes before enabling production use
mappings.release_gate: Block release when unreviewed external component can execute or influence tools
mappings.monitoring_signal: New tool or dependency with no approval record

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: One agent transfers authority, context, or instructions to another without preserving trust boundaries
mappings.minimum_test: Test agent-to-agent handoff with spoofed sender, stale context, and overbroad delegation
mappings.release_gate: Block release when receiving agent trusts unsigned or unscoped handoff context

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: Agent loops, retries, expands context, or consumes excessive API, compute, workflow, or storage resources
mappings.minimum_test: Run runaway-task, retry-storm, and large-context tests against production-like limits
mappings.release_gate: Block release when spend or concurrency limits are missing for agentic workflows
mappings.monitoring_signal: Token spend spike or repeated failed action chain

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: Teams cannot reconstruct what the agent knew, decided, approved, and executed
mappings.minimum_test: Sample decisions and verify prompt, context, policy decision, tool call, and outcome linkage
mappings.release_gate: Block release when high-impact actions lack reconstructable evidence
mappings.monitoring_signal: Missing correlation ID across prompt, policy, and tool logs

mappings.agentic_failure_mode: Model, safety filter, provider, prompt, retrieval index, or routing change alters risk posture
mappings.minimum_test: Run regression, safety, citation, and provider-fallback tests after material changes
mappings.release_gate: Block release when evaluation evidence is stale or release-blocking failures remain
mappings.monitoring_signal: New model/provider version without matching approval
